verdict.rationale: a-Shell operates directly on standard Unix-style files and lets users move data to/from other apps via pickFolder and iOS file sharing, implying no proprietary data lock-in, but there is no explicit 'export all data' feature or documentation addressing openness/portability as a stated goal. missing for 10: explicit data-export/backup documentation, statement about avoiding proprietary formats or lock-in, independent confirmation of full data portability.
